machine.description: Non-destructive testing (NDT) microfocus X-ray inspection station for detecting internal die-attach voids, wire bond sweeps, bridging, and solder ball voids within encapsulated IC packages.
machine.manufacturingProcess: A 130 kV open microfocus X-ray tube emits high-energy X-ray photons through encapsulated packages onto a high-resolution flat panel detector (FPD). A 5-axis motorized manipulator tilts and rotates the sample to generate 3D computed tomography (CT) slices.
subsystems: 130 kV Open Microfocus High-Voltage X-Ray Source
Lead-Shielded Radiation Enclosure with Safety Interlocks
Closed-Loop Water Chiller Tube Cooling System

components.name: 130 kV Microfocus Tube
components.function: Generates sub-micron focal spot X-ray beam.
components.importantParameters: High voltage (kV), target current (µA), target temp (°C).
components.degradationIndicators: Filament current degradation, target pitting, voltage arc.

components.name: Flat Panel Detector (FPD)
components.function: Converts X-ray photons into high-contrast digital radiograph.
components.importantParameters: Detector temperature (°C), pixel defect count, frame rate (fps).
components.degradationIndicators: Detector temperature rise, dead pixel cluster accumulation.

components.name: 5-Axis Manipulator Stage
components.function: Positions and rotates IC packages in X/Y/Z/Tilt/Rotate axes.

sensors.purpose: Measures tungsten target anode cooling temperature.

sensors.name: Manipulator Vibration
sensors.purpose: Monitors mechanical vibration of 5-axis sample manipulator.

operatingConditions.normalOperatingPressure: Atmospheric inside chamber, < 10^-4 Pa inside tube
operatingConditions.recommendedOperatingConditions: Chiller water flow > 3.0 L/min, radiation leakage < 0.5 µSv/h

maintenance.maintenanceAction: Filament replacement and vacuum tube roughing
maintenance.procedureSummary: Vent tube, replace tungsten filament hairpin, pump down to < 1x10^-4 Pa.

degradationIndicators.degradationSignificance: Accelerates target surface pitting and reduces image resolution

symptoms.recommendedAction: Rotate target to fresh spot and verify chiller coolant flow.

failureScenarios.symptom: X-Ray Target Anode Overheating & Voltage Instability
failureScenarios.recommendedAction: Flush tube cooling chiller and calibrate filament emission current.
